name: config-conditional-routes
description: No proxy.ts. Uses next.config.mjs rewrites and headers with has/missing (cookie/header) conditions to serve different static content on the same path. Documents a known gap: the runtime guard only covers proxy-matched routes, so these conditional static routes keep s-maxage.

routes.name: GET /pricing without x-tier header (default static content, keeps s-maxage — known gap)
GET /pricing with x-tier: enterprise header (rewritten to /pricing-enterprise, keeps s-maxage — known gap)
GET /offer without tier=vip cookie (missing condition rewrites to /banner-default, keeps s-maxage — known gap)
GET /offer with Cookie: tier=vip (has condition rewrites to /banner-vip, keeps s-maxage — known gap)
